_dataset: Replay R-1: Copernicus EMS activation EMSR838 flood extent, with ERA5 rain and GloFAS discharge from Open-Meteo

rainfall.csv.source: Open-Meteo historical weather API, model era5 (ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis, 0.25 degree, hourly precipitation)
rainfall.csv.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo, non-commercial use). Generated using Copernicus Climate Change Service information.
rainfall.csv.notes: 31 grid cells, 2 windows, 24552 hourly rows; saved responses in data/replay/raw/weather/ (manifest has each address and SHA-256)

river.csv.source: Open-Meteo flood API (GloFAS v4 river discharge, about 5 km, daily). For this period the values come from the archived forecast runs, not the consolidated reanalysis.
river.csv.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo, non-commercial use). GloFAS is a Copernicus Emergency Management Service product.
river.csv.notes: Three fixed points. danger_level is a labelled scenario parameter (a percentile of the baseline days), not an official level: {"GLOFAS-CHENAB":{"danger":981.66,"baselineDays":90,"baselineMin":80.47,"baselineMax":1591.21},"GLOFAS-RAVI":{"danger":305.23,"baselineDays":90,"baselineMin":1.47,"baselineMax":520.19},"GLOFAS-SUTLEJ":{"danger":393.46,"baselineDays":90,"baselineMin":0.03,"baselineMax":579.76}}

confirmed.csv.source: Copernicus Emergency Management Service rapid mapping, activation EMSR838, flood-extent layer (observedEventA) of the first delivered product of areas 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8; the quiet window is assumed, not confirmed
confirmed.csv.licence: Copernicus EMS products are free, open and free of charge. Credit: Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© European Union), EMSR838.
confirmed.csv.notes: Layers used: extent/AOI01.geojson (7108078 bytes, sha256 5892efbd95b5); extent/AOI02.geojson (2156456 bytes, sha256 6d18fbf8ab85); extent/AOI03.geojson (13765741 bytes, sha256 0402667d23f2); extent/AOI04.geojson (806916 bytes, sha256 d1f77b36668e); extent/AOI05.geojson (1441565 bytes, sha256 e2f1ef180dff); extent/AOI07.geojson (21168925 bytes, sha256 fdcb90d63800); extent/AOI08.geojson (23965507 bytes, sha256 6959976f5355)

plots.csv.source: Grid points sampled inside the published outlines of the same activation (scripts/replay/sample.ts, docs/REPLAY-METHOD.md): low_lying is assumed 1 for every point, river_reach is a nominal 48 km at 4 km/h
plots.csv.licence: Derived from the Copernicus EMS outlines above, same terms
plots.csv.notes: Not fields and not farmers: sample points of a flood map.
